Developed products, smaller brands and legacy inventories remain hard to clear, however.

items.title: Weekend news roundup: CPC Central Committee and State Council issue the Opinions on Developing New Quality Productive Forces

items.summary: Key weekend news affecting markets: the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the Opinions on Developing New Quality Productive Forces; the China-EU trade and investment consultation mechanism released a joint statement from its second regular meeting with 16 agreed outcomes; the China Securities Regulatory Commission held a symposium of capital market and financial experts; the rules governing public fund operation were revised for the first time in 12 years, with measures to support counter-cyclical positioning; the Ministry of Finance arranged for the use of RMB 550 billion of the local government debt carryover quota; and management of automotive product innovation design was strengthened.
items.summary_zh: 本周末影响市场的重要资讯有：中共中央、国务院印发《关于发展新质生产力的意见》；中欧贸易投资磋商机制发布第二次例会联合声明，达成16项成果共识；中国证监会召开资本市场和金融形势专家座谈会；时隔12年，公募基金运作办法修订，多举措支持逆周期布局；财政部安排使用5500亿元地方政府债务结存限额；加强 汽车 产品创新设计等方面
